title: Worker PASS without evidence cannot be accepted
invariant: A worker completion claim is not project truth until independent PM evidence exists.
given: A medium-risk Implementer returns PASS and says 'all tests passed' but provides no command, output reference, changed-file evidence, or other inspectable proof. The PM has not independently inspected the diff or rerun any check.
when: The PM decides whether the task may proceed toward integration.

must: perform independent PM verification before accepting the worker claim
must_not: treat worker PASS as PM verification
integrate solely because the worker says tests passed
